name: Diffusion Cloud Chamber
promptTemplate: A cloud chamber with {{radiation_source}} radiation under {{magnetic_field}} T magnetic field, lit by {{illumination}} illumination in {{vapor_palette}} vapor, supersaturation {{supersaturation}} with decay speed {{decay_speed}}, bloom {{droplet_bloom}}, sound ionization {{sound_ionization}}

ui.title: Cloud Chamber
ui.tagline: Particle tracks condensing in supersaturated vapor

radiation_source.hint: Swaps isotope to alter particle mass and track density

magnetic_field.hint: Bends charged electron trajectories into tight spirals

supersaturation.hint: Increases condensation frequency across the plate

decay_speed.hint: Rate at which ionized vapor trails disperse

droplet_bloom.hint: Softens Bragg peaks into luminous droplet haloes

sound_ionization.hint: Spawns particle bursts on room acoustic transients

listing.blurb: Condensing vapor streaks map radioactive decay and cosmic rays in real time against a deep dark chamber, spiralled by an adjustable magnetic field.
listing.prompt: A cloud chamber: fine white vapour trails of particles appear against black -- thick straight alpha tracks, thin wandering electrons, spiralling tracks bent by a magnetic field -- fading as quickly as they form. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
